seo.ogTitle: Fran Sánchez — Python Engineer, AI & Platform
seo.ogDescription: Production RAG pipelines, Apache Airflow orchestration and full-stack TypeScript. Selected work, experience and contact details.

hero.paragraph1: I build and run production systems in Python — retrieval pipelines, orchestration, and the services around them — and I ship the interfaces that sit on top, in React and TypeScript.
hero.paragraph2: I'm passionate about turning real-world problems into practical, well-engineered solutions.

job1.details: A role that spans Python and platform engineering, full-stack development, and automation. I build and operate a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline that ingests and indexes around 70,000 Spanish public-procurement documents a day; tuning the retrieval and pre-filtering tenders raised answer accuracy from 30% to 70%, on a two-engineer team. On the automation side I orchestrate UiPath robots from Apache Airflow DAGs, bringing scheduling, dependency management, retry logic and observability to automations that previously ran as isolated scheduled tasks, and I build automations for government-sector clients that remove around 50 hours of manual processing a month. As a front-end developer I work on a large-scale project for the Canary Islands Government, specifically the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Fisheries and Food Sovereignty, building production applications for data management and open data initiatives in the agricultural and fisheries domains — one of two developers responsible for the front end in a four-developer team, on a rebuild that cut page load times by 40%. I also work as an RPA Developer for Universidad de La Laguna, designing and maintaining UiPath automations for administrative and operational processes. Along the way I introduced Git workflow, shared component libraries and GitHub Actions CI/CD to a team that had previously worked only in low-code RPA tooling.
technologies: Python & AI: Python, FastAPI, Haystack, Qdrant, Ollama, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
Orchestration & Platform: Apache Airflow, Docker, Docker Compose, GitHub Actions CI/CD, Git workflows
Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Vite, React Native, Redux Toolkit, RTK Query, Material UI (MUI)
Backend & Data: Java Spring Boot, Node.js, PostgreSQL

job2.details: RPA Developer and Support Lead on a large-scale Siemens Gamesa project. Built automations in UiPath, Automation Anywhere and Power Automate (desktop and cloud flows): SAP and Excel data reconciliation for the logistics department, and email-to-portal routing of turbine incident and missing-part reports into internal and SCADA systems, plus around six further automations in maintenance. Led an international support team of four and cut average ticket resolution from 48 hours to 4 by replacing one-off fixes with a library of reusable components.

job3.details: Twelve months of full-time, self-funded retraining alongside my hospitality job, building projects end to end rather than following tutorials:
technologies: React.js to build web applications, including the MERN stack and Next.js.
JavaScript as my main language, and the D3.js library for data visualisation projects.
CSS including SASS, SCSS, Bootstrap, Tailwind, Material UI, Styled Components, and Chakra UI to style my websites.
TypeScript to add static typing to my more robust projects, providing an extra level of correctness.
Git to store my projects, track versions, and manage changes.

job4.details: Creation, evaluation, and correction of data related to maps, products, and online advertisements in order to train various AI systems.
